staticText: Source-labelled periodic table lookup for all 118 recognized elements using conventional IUPAC placement and CIAAW 2024 abridged standard atomic weights. Elements without a CIAAW standard atomic weight must be labelled that way; do not substitute an isotope mass number. Category and f-block boundaries are conventional classroom groupings, while full weights, intervals, uncertainties, laboratory values, and assessed-work requirements must be checked against the linked official source. Search, filtering, quiz, copy, TXT, and print output run locally.
